question_text: An otherwise healthy 16-year-old girl comes to the physician because she has not had a menstrual period. Examination shows normal breast development. There is coarse pubic and axillary hair. Pelvic examination shows a blind vaginal pouch. Ultrasonography shows normal ovaries and an atretic uterus. Which of the following is the most likely underlying cause of this patient's symptoms?

            ### Question
            An otherwise healthy 16-year-old girl comes to the physician because she has not had a menstrual period. Examination shows normal breast development. There is coarse pubic and axillary hair. Pelvic examination shows a blind vaginal pouch. Ultrasonography shows normal ovaries and an atretic uterus. Which of the following is the most likely underlying cause of this patient's symptoms?

            ### Options
    opa. Deficiency of 5-alpha reductase
opb. End-organ insensitivity to androgens
opc. Monosomy of sex chromosomes
opd. Agenesis of the paramesonephric duct
ope. Deficiency of 17-alpha-hydroxylase

            ### Instructions:
            - Keep steps simple, each step just one state or outcome.
            - '->' separates each step.

            ### Output Format:
            Start each chain with "CHAIN:" on a new line.
            Example:
            CHAIN: "Insulin" -> "decreased blood glucose" -> "improved metabolic state" -> 90%
